fixtures.description: Help exits 0 with plain text on the root, every command, and through the help command; an unknown help topic is a caller error; --version prints the declared line.
Unknown commands, flags, and malformed flag values, plus missing and extra positionals, are usage errors: exit 2 with the app's error output and a diagnostic.
SIGINT exits 130 and SIGTERM 143 when the app does not own signals.
An app that declares handler_owned_signals chooses its own exit code; the library does not override it.
Single-dash long flags are rewritten, while declared shorthands, value-taking flags, the -- terminator, NoInterspersed, and leaf-only flags before a subcommand keep their meanings.
A command writes stdout as its output.mode declares: one JSON value, plain text, or nothing.
